therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Myeloablative conditioning to eliminate residual leukemic cells and create space for donor stem cell engraftment
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Eradication of minimal residual disease and replacement of diseased hematopoietic system
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Older patients with acute myeloid leukemia in first complete remission
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: 2 Year Disease Free Survival In Unrelated Donor Recipient Group

results.effect_size: 40% (95% CI: 29-55) 2-year disease-free survival in unrelated donor recipients
results.dose_information: Fludarabine and busulfan given IV as conditioning regimen

context.duration: 2 years primary follow-up, up to 5 years for safety
